answer: We model decentralized peer validation as an artificial immune network where agent nodes function as antibodies detecting anomalous coordinated payloads. Analogous to a reef resisting a tide of invasive species in a managed garden, the protocol triggers exponential consensus resistance via adaptive thresholding to sequester Sybil clusters. A robust Nash equilibrium is enforced through mandatory staking collateral and slashing penalties, proving negative expected attack utility across all malicious strategies.
